metadata.description: Marketplace for the extractable software-development PROCESS kit (idea→done lifecycle, gates, roles, DoD, safety). Local/offline-friendly: add via `/plugin marketplace add ./core-harness`, then `/plugin install harness@prenter-harness`. Version follows core-harness/VERSION (KIT_VERSION — the release train; sync is factory-gated).

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Tech/sistema-agnostic dev-process: 10-state spine + {G,R,C,D} phases, refinement/architect/dev/auditor roles, TDD/DoD live-verify, learning-capture, git/parallel safety, embedded telemetry (KIT-03). Reads the seam (project.config.yaml) instead of naming a stack. Multisistema = sistemas.active with one entry.
